name: cluster_baseline
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk Kubernetes cluster baseline (control plane, networking, and optional system node group), provisionable across any supported cloud. The target cloud is selected via the `cloud` attribute — AWS (EKS), Azure (AKS), GCP (GKE), or bare Kubernetes (K8S_ONLY) — and defaults to AWS.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this cluster baseline.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the cluster baseline.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs for the cluster. For cloud clusters leave unset — inherited from the linked network (network_id). Set explicitly when importing an on-premise / K8S_ONLY cluster, which has no linked network to inherit from. Not used when cloud is K8S_ONLY and mode is Import — use scope_id instead.

attributes.name: scope_id
attributes.description: Scope ID for the cluster, sent as a top-level request field. Required (and only applicable) when cloud is K8S_ONLY and mode is Import — importing an existing installer-provisioned cluster by its scope. For all other cloud/mode combinations use scope_ids instead.

attributes.name: network_id
attributes.description: ID of the network baseline whose VPC and subnets this cluster will use. The cluster inherits its region, VPC, subnets, and scope from this network. Required unless cloud is K8S_ONLY (which provisions no cloud network).

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Cloud region (e.g. us-east-1). For Create, inherited from the linked network (network_id) — leave unset. Required for Import (identifies where the existing cluster runs).

attributes.name: vpc_id
attributes.description: VPC ID for the cluster (AWS only). Inherited from the linked network (network_id); computed, not user-settable. For Azure see azure.vnet_id.

attributes.name: subnet_ids
attributes.description: Subnet IDs for the cluster (AWS only). Inherited from the linked network (network_id); computed, not user-settable. For Azure see azure.node_subnet_id / azure.pod_subnet_id.

attributes.name: cluster_type
attributes.description: Cluster mode: Standard (self-managed/managed node groups) or Auto (cloud-managed node lifecycle, e.g. EKS Auto Mode). Auto is AWS (EKS) only; Azure (AKS) supports only Standard.

attributes.name: cloud
attributes.description: Cloud provider the cluster targets. Valid values: Aws, Azure, Gcp, K8S_ONLY. Immutable after creation. Defaults to Aws.

attributes.name: skip_attribute_auto_creation
attributes.description: Skip automatic creation of cluster attributes (add-ons/managed components) during provisioning. When unset, follows the server default; set true to fully self-manage cluster attributes.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Provisioning mode: Create (provision a new cluster) or Import (adopt an existing cluster, identified by name + region + cloud; version, VPC, and subnets are auto-discovered). Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Kubernetes major.minor version for the cluster (e.g. "1.34"). Required when mode is Create; auto-discovered when mode is Import. The live cluster's version is read back at major.minor precision (e.g. AKS's resolved "1.35.6" is stored as "1.35"). Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: api_server_visibility
attributes.description: Visibility of the Kubernetes API server endpoint.

attributes.name: control_plane_logging
attributes.description: Control plane log types to enable (api, audit, authenticator, controllerManager, scheduler). AWS (EKS) only — not supported for Azure (AKS uses diagnostic settings). When unset, defaults to none (server-assigned; list attributes take no static default).

attributes.name: cluster_ip_cidr
attributes.description: CIDR block for the Kubernetes service IP range (e.g. 172.20.0.0/16). Defaults to the cloud provider's default when unset.

attributes.name: domain_name_filter
attributes.description: Comma-joined list of Route53 hosted-zone names that external-dns should manage for this cluster.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version.

attributes.name: system_node_group
attributes.description: Optional default system managed node group provisioned alongside the cluster. AWS (EKS) only — for Azure (AKS) use azure.system_node_pool instead. Leave unset to provision a bare cluster with no node groups.

attributes.name: instance_type
attributes.description: EC2 instance type for the system node group (e.g. t3.medium).

attributes.name: min_size
attributes.description: Minimum node count (must be >= 1).

attributes.name: max_size
attributes.description: Maximum node count (must be >= min_size).

attributes.name: node_subnet_ids
attributes.description: Private subnet IDs the system node group is placed in. Populated server-side from the linked network's private subnets.

attributes.name: azure
attributes.description: Azure-specific (AKS) cluster configuration. Set only when cloud is Azure; ignored for other clouds. The VNet, subnets, region, and scope are derived from the linked network (network_id).

attributes.name: network_mode
attributes.description: AKS networking mode. AzureCniPodSubnet requires an AksPods subnet on the linked network.

attributes.name: enable_agic
attributes.description: Enable the Application Gateway Ingress Controller (AGIC) add-on. Requires the linked network to have an Application Gateway subnet.

attributes.name: enable_workload_identity
attributes.description: Enable Azure AD Workload Identity (and the AKS OIDC issuer) for the cluster, allowing pods to authenticate to Azure AD via federated credentials instead of static secrets. See azure_oidc_issuer_url for the resulting issuer URL.

attributes.name: system_node_pool
attributes.description: The AKS system node pool.

attributes.name: vm_size
attributes.description: Azure VM size for the node pool (e.g. Standard_DS2_v2).

attributes.name: count
attributes.description: Initial node count (must be >= 1).

attributes.name: enable_auto_scaling
attributes.description: Enable the AKS cluster autoscaler for this node pool.

attributes.name: min_count
attributes.description: Minimum node count when autoscaling (must be >= 1).

attributes.name: max_count
attributes.description: Maximum node count when autoscaling (must be >= min_count).

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Tags applied to the AKS cluster. The platform adds its own managed `duplocloud-ai-*` tags server-side; those are filtered out of state so only your tags are managed by Terraform.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status.

attributes.name: cluster_baseline_id
attributes.description: ID of this cluster baseline, for reference by dependent resources.

attributes.name: cluster_id
attributes.description: Cloud-native identifier of the provisioned cluster, regardless of cloud — the EKS cluster ARN on AWS or the AKS cluster resource ID on Azure.

attributes.name: cluster_arn
attributes.description: ARN of the provisioned cluster (AWS only).

attributes.name: helpdesk_vpc_peering
attributes.description: AWS only. Read-only copy of the linked network's helpdesk VPC peering settings. The platform copies this across from `network_id`'s network on every write — it is never accepted from the client — and uses it to open inbound 443 for the helpdesk CIDR on the EKS control-plane security group, which is created per-cluster and is separate from the network's own security group. Null when the linked network has no peering configured, or when the cluster was given a VPC directly instead of a network. Change the setting on the network baseline, not here.

attributes.name: enabled
attributes.description: Whether helpdesk VPC peering is active for the linked network.

attributes.name: helpdesk_vpc_id
attributes.description: ID of the helpdesk VPC the linked network peers with.

attributes.name: helpdesk_account_id
attributes.description: AWS account that owns the helpdesk VPC.

attributes.name: helpdesk_region
attributes.description: Region of the helpdesk VPC; only meaningful when the peering crosses regions.

attributes.name: helpdesk_vpc_cidr_blocks
attributes.description: Helpdesk VPC CIDR blocks allowed inbound on 443 on the EKS control-plane security group.

attributes.name: cluster_endpoint
attributes.description: Kubernetes API server endpoint URL.

attributes.name: oidc_issuer_url
attributes.description: OIDC issuer URL for IRSA.

attributes.name: certificate_authority
attributes.description: Base64-encoded cluster certificate authority data.

attributes.name: cluster_sg_id
attributes.description: Cluster security group ID (AWS only).

attributes.name: cluster_all_host_sg_id
attributes.description: Security group ID applied to all cluster hosts.

attributes.name: stack_id
attributes.description: Provisioned infrastructure stack ID.

attributes.name: azure_resource_group
attributes.description: Azure only. Resource group the AKS cluster was provisioned into.

attributes.name: azure_node_resource_group
attributes.description: Azure only. AKS-managed node resource group (the 'MC_' group).

attributes.name: azure_fqdn
attributes.description: Azure only. FQDN of the AKS API server.

attributes.name: azure_oidc_issuer_url
attributes.description: Azure only. OIDC issuer URL for workload identity.

attributes.name: azure_provisioning_state
attributes.description: Azure only. Provisioning state of the AKS cluster (e.g. Succeeded).
